metadata.description: Loop Engineering skills — a fork of mattpocock/skills carrying only the ticket-driven loop core, Paseo adapter, and deterministic driver (ADR-0001).

plugins.name: loop-engineering
plugins.description: Deterministic loop driver for ticket cycles — scripts the routing spine (readiness gate + type dispatch) and the close-out loop (review → derived verdict → fix → merge → close) and invokes external doing-skills as leaves (ADR-0008).

plugins.name: ticket-workflow-core
plugins.description: Runtime-neutral core for ticket-driven workflows — abstract primitives for execution, dependencies, failover, reasoning depth, gates, and supervision.

plugins.name: tickets-to-paseo
plugins.description: Paseo adapter for ticket-workflow-core — maps abstract primitives to Paseo 0.1.110 surface (chat rooms, schedules, prompt contracts, supervisor).
